builds.notes:
• Sign in with the feature-flagged tester account and confirm Notifications appears.
• Add or update an involved transaction and verify its group and share.
• Open it and verify “View in group” briefly highlights the transaction.
• Generate multiple notifications and verify the unread count opens the panel.
• Verify notification UI remains hidden for non-enabled accounts.

• Complete the one-time Terms onboarding.
• Report inappropriate content and confirm submission succeeds.
• Block an abusive user and confirm the action succeeds.
• Verify blocked activity disappears immediately.

• Sign in with Google, Apple, and email.
• Complete the one-time post-login safety setup.
• Confirm it shows the community rules, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy.
• Report objectionable activity and block an abusive member.
• Verify blocked content is filtered from activity.

• Open Support from Profile.
• Choose an account request topic.
• Choose a data request topic and confirm it remains selected.

• Add a new person to a group.
• Reuse a person from another group.
• Invite a person to link an account.
• Remove a person who has not linked an account.

• Reuse a person from another group.
• Remove a person without an account or email.

• Choose a sign-in method and complete sign-in.
• Join a group.
• Add an expense.
• Settle up.

• Choose a sign-in method and complete sign-in.
• Join a group.
• Add an expense.
• Settle up.

• Sign in with Apple on an iPad.
• Confirm no beta-only messaging appears.
• Delete an account from Profile.

• Start account deletion from Profile.
• Confirm deletion through email.
• Sign in again if needed.

• Confirm SharedMoney branding appears throughout the app.
• Sign in and open a legacy link.
• Send and accept a group invitation.
• Create an expense and complete a settlement.
• Confirm iOS assets load without the build 49 bundle-path error.

• Sign in with Apple and Google on iOS.
• Sign in with email and password.
• Test the group expense flows.
• Delete an account from Profile.
